label: sec:brings-surface-orphan-reconnect-intro
html: Comparing the Bring surface fibre at the substrate parameter q_0 against its half-power specialization q_0^{1/2} makes explicit the geometric mechanism of two-nucleon exchange and discrete charge symmetry: the inter-nucleon meson channel is realized as a colour tube connecting adjacent sheets of \Sigma_4, while charge conjugation \mathcal{C} acts as an orientation-reversing involution that swaps colour and conjugate-colour sheets.
